away.summary: The Blues (2-2-1) are dealing with several injuries, including Mailloux (hand), Tucker (knee), Toropchenko (upper body), and Dube (neck). They are recalling forward Dylan Peterson from Springfield for his expected NHL debut. Goaltending is projected with Joel Hofer listed first, followed by Jordan Binnington.

home.summary: The Senators (5-1-0) are missing key defenders Sanderson (undisclosed), Zub (knee), Eklund (ankle), MacDermid (upper body), Crotty (undisclosed, IR), and Matinpalo (upper body). They have recalled Jorian Donovan from Belleville for the second time this season, who could enter the lineup. Goaltending is projected with Samuel Ersson listed first, followed by Linus Ullmark.
